purpose: Document Pematangsiantar local registry custody and bounded anonymous BHUMI/ATLAS checks without treating viewer configuration or failed proxy responses as parcel geometry evidence.
assessment: A local registry custodian is evidenced by official ATR/BPN and city-government sources. The official BHUMI help material documents parcel layers and ATLAS integration, and current public configuration names a PersilHak WMS route with NIB as a safe identity-like displayed property. Anonymous public proxy attempts returned the BHUMI shell/404, not capabilities or feature geometry, so the packet is complete for research but held for runtime qualification.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody is evidenced by the official ATR/BPN listing of Kantor Pertanahan Kota Pematangsiantar and official city-government reporting of its land-registration/certificate work. No open local parcel database or verified parcel API response was obtained.
